content.text: Systemic autoimmune connective tissue disorder where collagen deposition leads to fibrosis of the skin & internal organs (lung, heart, kidney, GI tract)
⤷ associated w/ greater internal organ involvement
: DMARDs – methotrexate, cyclophosphamide for refractory cases
inflammatory disease w/ symmetric polyarthritis, bone erosion, cartilage destruction, & joint structure loss
: hyperplastic synovial tissue (pannus) leads to joint destruction (T cell mediated)
▪︎MC affects small joints (i.e., wrist, MCP, PIP, MTP, ankle)
joint narrowing, osteopenia, bone & joint erosions
